literal_meaning: ঘোড়ার রাশ বা লাগাম (rein or bridle for a horse)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখে কোনো লাগাম নেই, যা মনে আসে তাই বলে ফেলে।
জীবনে কিছু লাগাম রাখতে হবে, অন্যথায় সবকিছু নষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: He has no rein on his mouth; he says whatever comes to his mind.
One must keep some restraint in life, otherwise everything will be ruined.
history: Derived from equestrian terminology in traditional Bengali rural life, symbolizing control over animals and metaphorically over human impulses.
note: Often used in contexts implying lack of self-control, especially in speech.
